content.synthesis_cross_cutting_insights:
Comparing the two project surfaces where Le Contel intersects funded hiring lines:

- **Mechanism**: In Pacte-Espace (https://atst.osups.universite-paris-saclay.fr/postdoctoral-position-at-lpp-on-studies-and-measurements-of-the-near-earth-electromagnetic-environment/), the PI sits at CEA (Jean-Francois Ripoll) while Le Contel functions as on-site LPP scientific contact alongside Alessandro Retino; in MMELODIC (https://atst.osups.universite-paris-saclay.fr/postdoc-mmelodic-2025/), the PI sits inside LPP itself (Lina Hadid, also a PhD alumna of LPP per her LinkedIn - https://fr.linkedin.com/in/lina-hadid-86004268), with Le Contel not named. This suggests Le Contel contributes expertise but is not the application-of-record PI for the postdoc lines that surface publicly.
- **Scope**: Both projects target the near-Earth magnetosphere - Pacte-Espace via electromagnetic environment characterisation, MMELODIC via mercury's magnetosphere dynamics and ion composition. The shared scientific theme lines up with Le Contel's portal fingerprint ("Magnetopause 33%, Magnetosheath 33%") and topic list ("electrons, whistlers, ions"). The two scopes overlap on instrumentation/wave-particle physics but differ in planetary body (Earth vs Mercury) and primary PI institution (external CEA vs internal LPP).
- **Trade-offs**: Outreach to Le Contel via either project must reflect that the application-of-record PI is elsewhere; a junior candidate pursuing the position should be steered to the named PI's lab page rather than via Le Contel's individual contact.
- **Evidence base**: One project is publicly archived on the CNRS Emploi portal (URL with UMR7648-OLILEC-001 prefix; CNRS number 692 offers at portal), the other only on ATST (Action Thematique Soleil-Terre). The CNRS Emploi portal link is the strongest traceability record for the Pacte-Espace post; the MMELODIC post lacks an equivalent CNRS portal anchor in the material returned.
- **Time horizon**: Both postings have elapsed deadlines (2023 and 2025). As of 2026-07-11, they are Closed/Historical. The DIM-ORIGINES parent programme holds a separate 2026 call (cloture 29 May 2026), which is the natural place to scan for any newly awarded project with Le Contel's name as PI/co-PI - but no individual award listing was identified.
